title: The Memory of First Snow
youtube_title: The Memory of First Snow | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Kei about memory of a first snow, told with the pauses left in. Kei wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
